name: Core Pack
description: Default Truth or Dare prompts across all levels

prompts.text: What's the most embarrassing song on your playlist?
What's a talent you wish you had?
Who in this room would you trust with a secret?
What's your go-to comfort food?
What's the weirdest dream you remember?
Which friend here has the best style?
What's a hobby you pretend to like more than you do?
If you could teleport anywhere right now, where would you go?
Do your best celebrity impression for 15 seconds.
Send a voice note complimenting the person to your left.
Speak in an accent for the next two rounds.
Show the last photo in your camera roll (that you're okay sharing).
Let the group invent a nickname for you that sticks tonight.
Do 10 jumping jacks on camera.
Draw a portrait of another player in 30 seconds and show it.
Tell a joke — if no one laughs, you owe another dare next turn.
Who was your last crush, and what drew you in?
What's the boldest thing you've ever done on a night out?
Who in this room would you most want to go on a spontaneous trip with?
Have you ever had a crush on a friend's partner? Be honest.
What's a text you regret sending?
What's your biggest turn-on that surprises people?
Rate everyone in the room's smile from 1–10 (no ties).
Who here would you kiss if you had to choose one person?
Compliment the person across from you… in the most dramatic way possible.
Slow dance to a song of the group's choosing for 20 seconds.
Let someone else write a flirty bio for your dating profile out loud.
Call or voice-message someone and say something silly the group scripts.
Give a 10-second seductive stare to each player.
Let the group rearrange your hair however they want.
Post a story saying 'Ask me anything' for 5 minutes (or screenshot proof you would).
Read a romantic poem to someone in the room with full commitment.
What's the most scandalous rumor about you — and is any of it true?
What's something you've never told your closest friends?
Describe your wildest night in one sentence — no filtering.
Who in this room intimidates you the most and why?
Have you ever ghosted someone? Spill the details.
What's your most toxic trait in relationships?
What's the riskiest place you've ever hooked up?
Name someone you've stalked online more than you should admit.
Let the group go through your recent search history for 30 seconds.
Eat something weird the group invents from what's nearby.
Text your ex 'I miss you' — then show the screen (or take a skip).
Imitate another player's most annoying habit until they laugh.
Do a dramatic confession of love to a random object for 20 seconds.
Let someone else control your phone for one safe, non-destructive minute.
Wear your clothes inside-out for the next three rounds.
Sing a song chosen by the group at maximum volume.
What's your deepest fantasy you rarely say out loud?
What's the most inappropriate thought you've had about someone in this room?
Describe your ideal night with someone — no soft edges.
What's a hard limit you've crossed and regretted?
Who here would you choose for a one-night adventure — and why them?
What's the most jealous you've ever been? Tell the story.
Share the most NSFW compliment you've ever received.
What would you do if you had 24 hours with no consequences?
Whisper something filthy to the person of the group's choosing (off-mic if needed).
Act out your best 'movie seduction' scene for 30 seconds.
Let the group choose a dare that's one level spicier than this one.
Describe in detail how you'd kiss someone in this room.
Remove one accessory or outer layer for the rest of the game.
Roleplay being someone's 'date' for the next two rounds.
Answer the next truth from another player with zero filter.
Give a slow, deliberate compliment to each player about something physical.
What first attracted you to your partner?
What's one thing you wish your partner did more often?
Feed each other something while maintaining eye contact.
Give your partner a 20-second massage on camera.
Your team must invent and perform a 10-second cheer.
Your whole team must roast the other team for 20 seconds — keep it playful.
As a team, vote: who on the other team would survive a reality show?
